title: An ext-v tag that ext-release made is never sent when sync --push rebases the commit it points at, and ext-release refuses to make it again
goal: after sync --push rebases a commit an ext-v tag points at, kg_sync.tags_to_push lists the tag on the rebased commit, so the tag reaches the integration remote with that push

gates.question: How does sync find an ext-v tag whose commit a rebase rewrote, and what does it do with it?
options: match by patch id and move the tag onto the rebased commit, inside tags_to_push
list the tag at its old commit and push that
gates.recommendation: match by patch id and move the tag onto the rebased commit, inside tags_to_push
gates.answer: match by patch id and move the tag onto the rebased commit, inside tags_to_push
